name: Georg Hanson
original_name: ゲオルク・ハイネセン
source: One of the top MIT students and Kira's friend. He has womanizer reputation at university. Georg was also hired by Gloria family. Before Kira arrived to Gloria's mansion he had already chosen to tutor Etana, the oldest daughter.
